<thought>Identify a retrosynthetic template that forms a sulfonamide (sulfonamides) from a sulfonyl chloride and an amine. Use the catalog search with functional_groups_formed set to “sulfonamides”. Then find a template for amide formation (amide) from an acyl chloride and an amine. Both templates will be used to construct a ≤3‑step route.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
